reading_notes: The paired terminal labels on both inductor symbols read 1/3 on the X-side and 2/4 on the R4 side; each pair is externally tied on the drawn circuit. This does not establish the internal winding or coupling construction.
The 00 vertical rail crosses X2 and X1 without junction dots. The 12P rail crosses 00, X2 and X1 without junction dots.
E1 and E3 right sides join 00; E2 and E4 right sides join 12P. The four links are drawn open, so the installed combination is not identified by this page.
Closing E1+E2 or E3+E4 gives opposite DC yoke-bias polarities; that pair selection is a functional inference, not an observed installed setting.
The parts list gives R4 as 1000 ohm +/-10% and R2 as 150 ohm +/-5%. It identifies L1 and L2 as type 1.11.017324.0/01 but gives no inductance, resistance or coupling.

E1_E2.effect: L1/R4 end_a at 00 and R2 end at 12P
